title: Append of the confirmed Pulsar Analysis measurement list to a strictly admitted saved-results file, as a new download
sourceNote: CLEA_VEO.exe (VIREO). Static listings, a bounded static disassembly capture and an import-identity parse only; no original binary bytes are copied into the product.
scope: A new bounded web download: the exact bytes of a supplied file admitted by the strict saved-rows reader, followed by the confirmed web rows. The selected file is never modified. Not the native Save, not the raw PLR recording writer, not the native rewrite fallback or truncation, not audio.
newline: The admitted target's own line ending (CRLF or LF) for every new row (WEB-NAP-03 policy; the native WriteLn flag at TextRec+6 is unknown)

limitTags.maxRows: W: saved-rows reader bound, applied to old plus new rows
limitTags.maxBytes: W: saved-rows reader bound, applied to the complete result before it is allocated; also the bound checked before a target is read
limitTags.maxRowBytes: W: saved-rows reader bound for each new row

methods.reaPreserved: Eligible preserved REA research of R-RX10 (result-writer-code-only.asm, fresh-open-mode-dispatch.asm, fresh-write-newline.asm); REA was not invoked again for this increment.
methods.boundedBackendCapture: A separately authorized bounded static objdump capture of 0x403874..0x403a20 (APPEND-CAPTURE-RECEIPT.json, stdout SHA-256 below), because the installed REA wrapper cannot capture an address range. It is a static disassembly of the same input, not an REA run, not execution and not emulation.
methods.importIdentities: A bounded PE import-address/stub identity parse (APPEND-IMPORT-IDENTITIES.json): 0x4012d8 CreateFileA, 0x4012e8 GetFileSize, 0x401300 ReadFile, 0x401310 SetEndOfFile, 0x401318 SetFilePointer, 0x4012d0 CloseHandle, 0x4012e0 GetFileType, 0x4012f0 GetStdHandle.

contracts.contract: The empty-list refusal runs before the append branch.
contracts.code: src/core/pulsarResultsAppend.ts buildResultsAppend step 1 (no-rows before the target is examined)

contracts.contract: With the append flag the writer opens through 0x4037bc (mode 0xd7b3 via 0x40374c) and checks IOResult 0x403324; success jumps to the row loop 0x5702ab, so no header is written.
contracts.code: buildResultsAppend writes no header; the target bytes are the prefix

contracts.contract: A failed append open falls back to Rewrite 0x4037b0 and writes a fresh header.
contracts.code: none: any target problem is a refusal with no bytes (AP-16)

contracts.contract: Mode 0xd7b3 backend: CreateFileA with read/write access, share mode 1 and disposition 3 (open existing), GetFileSize, SetFilePointer to max(size-128,0), ReadFile of 128 bytes, scan for the byte 0x0e; when found, seek back from the end and SetEndOfFile (truncation); when absent, the file pointer stays at the end. No Ctrl-Z (0x1a) claim is made: the compared byte in the listing is 0x0e.
contracts.code: none: an admitted target contains only 0x20..0x7E plus CR/LF, so the truncation branch cannot apply (analyst inference, not an observation)

contracts.contract: Each retained row string is written by ordinal, exactly, followed by WriteLn.
contracts.code: buildResultsAppend steps 6 and 7; appendPulsarResults uses the stored row texts verbatim

contracts.contract: The writer closes the file (0x403bc8) and calls the post-write reset 0x56fe6c.
contracts.code: none: a download request changes no analysis state (WEB-NAP-04)

contracts.contract: WriteLn 0x40460c appends CR LF when TextRec+6 bit 0 is set, else LF; the runtime flag is unknown.
contracts.code: new rows use the target's own line ending (WEB-NAP-03)

contracts.contract: Only a target the strict admitSavedRows profile admits; it is refused, never repaired, rewritten or overwritten. A source not created by the reader (spread, clone, fabricated) is refused as unowned. Static evidence covers only the writer listing (NAP-01..06) and the 0xd7b3 backend 0x403874..0x403a20; in those listings the only step that depends on an existing file's contents is the scan of the last 128 bytes (NAP-04), and a byte 0x0e found there truncates the file instead of appending to it as it is. The excluded raw Save caller may check more, and native behaviour on files outside the strict profile is unknown; here such files are refused.

The output is the exact target byte prefix (metadata and old rows lexically admitted by the strict reader (lines and field boundaries), never interpreted, rebuilt, reformatted or deduplicated) followed by the exact stored confirmed rows, checked by a strict readback and field agreement of the new rows.

New rows use the admitted target's line ending; combined rows at most 2000 and bytes at most 1 MiB, checked before allocation; new rows are lexically admitted (lines and field boundaries), and no number is interpreted, converted or reformatted.

A NEW download with the fixed name pulsar-results-appended.csv; the selected file is never changed and its name is shown only as text. No saved flag, reset, list, pending reading, storage or save-success claim.

Dialog session: snapshot of the confirmed list and generation; a new selection clears the target at once; unique read tokens; a pending read disables Download; route hide cancels a read and keeps an owned target; stale, lease and not-ready refusals. An explicit learner Cancel reading leaves the read-cancelled notice in the dialog's own role=status region (cleared by a new selection or close; a host cancellation leaves none; DOM exposure only, no screen-reader output claimed).

The common modal, action, PLR read, original-download and shared-data adoption guards cover the append dialog; Export and Append exclude each other and share one output claim taken before any browser call; a foreign modal blocks every append action.

evidenceRoot: complete research root, radio-rx12-results-append-20261025 and radio-rx10-save-results-20261025 (not published)
evidenceHashSource: EVIDENCE-SHA256.json of the RX12 evidence directory (values copied, not recomputed in this phase). The backend hash also matches APPEND-CAPTURE-RECEIPT.json. RECOVERED-CONTRACT.json, EVIDENCE-SHA256.json and APPEND-CAPTURE-RECEIPT.json are not themselves hashed in any receipt; their hashes are left to the coordinator.

golden.nature: Synthetic hand-authored target and expected files written before the implementation, frozen and verified by the coordinator (the earlier byte counts in the plan and a setup typo are superseded). Not original observations and not a runtime oracle. Their texts are embedded by hand in the unit test, and the App test checks the target prefix SHA-256.
